intro.line: What if Darsh actually locked in?

acts.label: Day 1: phone in a drawer
acts.line: Day one. His phone goes in a drawer. No reels, no dilly-dallying. Nine straight hours of real work, and the city starts building itself.

acts.label: Day 30: a certain website shuts down
acts.line: Day thirty. A certain website quietly shuts down its servers. Turns out, Darsh was their main user.

acts.label: Year 1: Type II civilization
acts.line: Year one. The work compounds. Launch pads fill the bay, a rocket goes up every minute, and humanity becomes a Type Two civilization.

title: What if sea level rose one kilometre?

intro.line: What if sea level rose by one whole kilometre?

acts.label: The harbour walls
acts.line: At first, nothing dramatic. The water creeps up the harbour walls, the quays flood, and the cars along the river are the first things to go.

acts.label: Every street a canal
acts.line: Then the parks go under. Every street becomes a canal, and the bottom floors of the whole city fill with sea water.

acts.label: Only the towers remain
acts.line: At a full kilometre, only the bridge towers and the tallest rooftops stay above the waves.

end.line: Every coastal city on Earth would look exactly like this.
end.title: Every coastal city. Gone.

title: What if everyone on Earth stood in one city?

intro.line: What if every single person on Earth stood in one city?

acts.label: 100,000 people
acts.line: First, the parks fill up. A hundred thousand people, and honestly, it still feels like a music festival.

acts.label: 10 million
acts.line: Then the bridges and the streets. Ten million people. Traffic stops forever, and nobody can find their friends.

acts.label: 8 billion
acts.line: Then every rooftop and every quay. Eight billion people, shoulder to shoulder, packed into one single city.

end.line: And somehow, the rest of the planet is completely empty.
end.title: The rest of Earth: empty.

title: What if it rained for 40 days straight?

intro.line: What if it rained for forty days straight, without stopping once?

acts.label: Day 1
acts.line: Day one. It is just a rainy day. Umbrellas come out, the gutters overflow, and nobody is worried yet.

acts.label: Day 20
acts.line: Day twenty. The river climbs over the quays, the roads close, and the park turns into a lake.

acts.label: Day 40
acts.line: Day forty. The water reaches the bridge deck, and the city is an island chain of rooftops.

end.line: And then, finally, the sun comes back out.
end.title: Then the sun came out.

title: What if it snowed for a whole month?

intro.line: What if this city got snow every single day for a whole month?

acts.label: Week 1
acts.line: Week one. The first flakes fall, the parks go white, and everyone pretends it is still pretty.

acts.label: Week 3
acts.line: Week three. Every roof and every street is buried, and the bridge is the only way across town.

acts.label: Week 4
acts.line: Week four. Schools are closed for good, and the whole city comes outside to build snowmen.

end.line: Honestly, it might be the best month this city ever had.
end.title: Best month ever?
